summary: Procore Technologies filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing completion of its previously announced acquisition of DroneDeploy, Inc. The July 27, 2026 merger agreement, structured as a reverse merger of Procore's subsidiary into DroneDeploy, closed September 9, 2026, leaving DroneDeploy a wholly-owned Procore subsidiary. Purchase price was approximately $845.0 million in cash, subject to customary working capital, transaction expense, cash, and indebtedness adjustments. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or financing terms are stated in this excerpt. Watch integration execution, purchase-accounting adjustments, and any earnout or holdback mechanics affecting final consideration.
